note: Both sets cover the same six facts with essentially the same bindings: 400 g total actuation force, 10 g max pull force per louver at axial rotation points, 2500 g (martensite) and 2900 g (austenite) pull forces, the 15-20C austenite range, and the theoretical 200C-to-cryogenic martensite transformation range. The only differences are cosmetic or minor: A keeps 'cryogenic temperatures' as the value while B truncates it to 'cryogenic', and the two attach different (both text-supported) conditions to the 15-20C range — A cites the Dynalloy wire specification, B cites the Irvine, CA annual temperature data. Neither set misbinds a value or invents anything, and both quotes support their claims.
